checks.detail: No lock waits: no session is blocked.

audit.report: A batch search reindex job (pid 778436) held a lock idle-in-transaction for 4.1 seconds, blocking all checkout traffic and driving success to 0% with $18,400/min at risk. The Database Guardian initially proposed waiting but switched to termination after trade-off analysis showed waiting would cost ~$366,743 in lost revenue versus a 3-minute replay cost for the interruptible batch job. The Continuity Guardian accepted immediately; the Authority authorized and the Executor terminated the blocker. Within 59 seconds the database was clear and checkout recovered to 100% success over 10 seconds, meeting the 95% SLO.
audit.root_cause: A long-running batch_replayable_search_reindex worker entered an idle-in-transaction state while holding locks required by checkout, stalling the critical path.
lessons: Add a statement_timeout or idle_in_transaction_session_timeout for batch_replayable_search_reindex workers so they self-terminate before blocking checkout for more than a few seconds.
Instrument the search_reindex job to emit heartbeat/checkpoint metrics; if the job stalls past its typical 1200 s runtime, alert on-call before it becomes a blocker.

Pre-register the search_reindex workload's replay cost (3 min) and interruptibility (may_interrupt=True) in the workload registry so the trade-off calculator can auto-approve termination without a full negotiation round.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian correctly reversed its initial wait proposal once hard numbers showed the 60-second tolerance and $366k cost of waiting; no round was wasted because the pivot happened inside the same round after probes returned. The Continuity Guardian did not miss evidence and raised no objections.
follow_ups: Configure idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = 5s for the batch_worker role to auto-abort stalled reindex workers.
Add a Prometheus alert on search_reindex runtime exceeding 1300 s with a runbook linking to this incident.
Extend the workload registry entry for search_reindex with explicit max_tolerable_block_seconds = 10 so future negotiations can skip the probe cycle.
